content.short: Daily on-chain rituals like GM, deploy and vote across 70+ mainnets, with points and loot boxes.
content.description: SurfLayer rewards consistent on-chain activity. Users send a daily GM, deploy contracts, vote and bridge on more than 70 mainnets and 19 testnets, from Base and Unichain to Plasma and Monad, earning SurfPoints that feed a SurfScore identity. Missions, a reward hub and loot boxes add prizes, and busier new chains pay more points per action.
